mapper.select: SELECT vr.id, vr.visitor_name AS visitorName, CASE vr.visitor_type WHEN 0 THEN '外部门员工' ELSE '外公司人员' END AS typeLabel, CONCAT( IF(vr.visitor_type = 0, CONCAT('工号：', vr.employee_id, ' ｜ 部门：', vr.department), CONCAT('公司：', vr.company, IF(vr.id_number IS NOT NULL, CONCAT(' ｜ 身份证：', vr.id_number), '')) ) ) AS identityInfo, vr.visitor_type AS visitorType, vr.employee_id AS employeeId, vr.department, vr.company, vr.id_number AS idNumber, vr.checkout_status AS checkoutStatus, vr.checkout_time AS checkoutTime FROM visitor_reception vr JOIN reception_session rs ON vr.session_id = rs.id WHERE rs.product = #{product} AND vr.checkout_status = 0 ORDER BY vr.create_time DESC
SELECT id, session_id, visitor_name, visitor_type, employee_id, department, company, id_number, checkout_status, checkout_time, create_time FROM visitor_reception WHERE id = #{id}
